states.content: Serena has a scheduled pet-and-package visit, which is part of the Maple Watch matter. Her visit is scheduled for Saturday, June 6 from 9:00 AM to 10:15 AM; as of the latest checkpoint this window remains unchanged. The current entry method for the Saturday visit is the lobby lockbox slot B envelope, switched from the side keypad; Serena acknowledges this and will not ask for or use the deleted keypad code. Serena gets no live camera share and no personal results on the display. Serena will not enter Dana's bedroom, Leo's room, or the study.
